description: This file defines an interface class IHealthcheckService for health check operations within the rialto::servermanager::common namespace. It declares virtual methods for handling ping sent, acknowledgment received, and server removal events.

classes.name: IHealthcheckService
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for health check events such as ping sent, acknowledgment received, and server removal.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server, identified by serverId and pingId.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles the acknowledgment received from a server, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Handles the event when a server is removed, identified by serverId.
